## Initiatives & Updates

### Travel reimbursement policy

PR here: [https://github.com/walletbeat/walletbeat/pull/713](https://github.com/walletbeat/walletbeat/pull/713)

Works by paying for average flight ticket + modal per-night stay cost + stipend.  
Cap on total trip expense, limit 2 trips/year/person, limit 2 people/events.

Feedback received so far:

- Incorporate more explicit requirements of impact, or explicit goal of socialization in future trips
- Will front money for Berlin Blockchain Week since the policy didn’t exist until now, but future trips will only be reimbursed afterwards (otherwise, can’t enforce requirement of impact)
